findings.message: Editing a private source URL silently deletes its stored token. The UI moves the '*' marker to the new URL, but the backend only preserves existingCred.Env[newURL]; the token remains keyed by oldURL and is subsequently dropped. Changing a branch or adding a .git suffix therefore breaks authentication unless the administrator re-enters the PAT. Implement an explicit credential transfer or require a replacement token.

Scheme-less URLs are normalized only in SourceURLs, leaving SourceURLCredentials keyed by the original input. For example, submitting 'gitlab.com/org/private.git' with a PAT changes the active URL to 'https://gitlab.com/org/private.git', so the credential loop rejects the original key as inactive. The request succeeds but discards the PAT and private-repository sync fails. Normalize credential keys alongside their source URLs.
